info.title: Orbscan Open API
info.description: REST endpoints for Polymarket trader activity, deposits & withdrawals, and per-transaction action details, sourced directly from on-chain data.

get.description: Returns paginated buy, sell, and redeem activity for a wallet across every Polymarket market it has touched. Results are ordered newest-first and paginated with an opaque cursor.

parameters.name: marketIds
parameters.description: Filter to one or more market IDs. Repeat the parameter to pass multiple IDs (e.g. `marketIds=2707644&marketIds=2682268`).

parameters.name: txHash
parameters.description: Filter to a single transaction hash. The value is automatically lower-cased before matching.

parameters.name: fromBlock
parameters.description: Only include activity at or after this block height.

parameters.name: toBlock
parameters.description: Only include activity at or before this block height.

parameters.name: fromTimestamp
parameters.description: Only include activity at or after this Unix timestamp, in seconds.

parameters.name: toTimestamp
parameters.description: Only include activity at or before this Unix timestamp, in seconds.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor. Pass the `nextCursor` (a base64 string) returned by the previous page to fetch the next page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of records per page. Defaults to 50, maximum 100. Values above 100 are capped at 100.

nextCursor.description: Opaque base64 cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more results.

get.description: Returns the trader's deposits and withdrawals, aggregated per transaction and ordered by time descending. Transfers from known reward / system addresses are excluded. Each record's `type` is either `deposit` (net inflow) or `withdrawal` (net outflow).

parameters.name: minDeposit
parameters.description: Minimum deposit amount to include. Withdrawals are always included regardless of this filter.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's `nextCursor`. Omit for the first page.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more results.

get.description: Returns all currently open positions for a wallet — every outcome token the wallet holds with a non-zero balance, along with pricing, PnL, and market metadata.

items.marketTitle: Bitcoin Up or Down - August 18, 1:30AM-1:35AM ET

get.description: Returns the trader's closed positions — outcome tokens the wallet previously held in markets that have since resolved. Ordered by market / most recent trade descending. Positions here have `balance: "0"` and `closed: true`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's `nextCursor`. Omit for the first page.

parameters.name: marketIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated market IDs to filter to (e.g. `?marketIds=1,2`).

items.marketTitle: Bitcoin Up or Down - August 18, 2:55AM-3:00AM ET

get.description: Returns all currently open combo (parlay) positions for a wallet. Each combo position contains multiple legs, each representing a single market outcome. The overall position is valued based on all legs resolving correctly.

get.description: Returns the trader's resolved / closed combo (parlay) positions, ordered by most recent trade descending.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's `nextCursor`. Omit for the first page.

parameters.name: marketIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated market IDs to filter to (e.g. `?marketIds=1,2`).

get.description: Returns a high-level portfolio summary for a wallet — the total mark-to-market value of all open positions, the USDC balance, and the combined portfolio value.
Resolves the wallet address for a given signer / trader address. Returns the resolved wallet address (lowercase) or `null` when no wallet is found.

walletAddress.description: Resolved wallet address (lowercase), or `null` when no wallet is found.

get.description: Returns the trader's reward records (yield, maker/taker rebates, referral rewards, etc.), ordered by block time descending.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma-separated activity types (e.g. `?types=YIELD,MAKER_REBATE`). Case-insensitive. Supported values: `YIELD`, `MAKER_REBATE`, `TAKER_REBATE`, `REFERRAL_REWARD`, `REWARD`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's `nextCursor`. Omit for the first page.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or `null` when there are no more results.

get.description: Returns a decoded, human-readable summary of a single transaction plus every individual on-chain action (fills) it contains. Useful for inspecting exactly what happened inside one trade.

bearerAuth.name: Authorization
bearerAuth.description: Pass your Orbscan API key as a Bearer token, formatted as `Bearer <your_api_key>`.

Unauthorized.description: The API key is missing or invalid.

price.description: Price per share as a decimal (0–1). Multiply by 100 to get cents.

usdcSize.description: Gross USDC value of the action.

netSharesTransferred.description: Net shares transferred (positive = received, negative = sent).

positionSide.description: Which outcome the trade is on.

liquidityRole.description: MAKER or TAKER, or null for non-trade actions such as redeems.

txHash.description: Transaction hash (records are aggregated per transaction).

amount.description: Amount, absolute value of the net flow (USDC).

address.description: Counterparty address (sender for deposits, receiver for withdrawals). For bridged deposits this may be the zero address.

proxyWallet.description: The trader's proxy wallet (the reward recipient).

fromAddress.description: Address the reward was sent from.

tokenId.description: Polymarket outcome token ID involved in this fill.

size.description: Number of shares in this fill.

price.description: Price per share as a decimal (0–1).

traderAddress.description: The primary wallet this transaction is attributed to.

sentence.example: Buy 3604.58 No for $3546.12269 in Will Bitcoin dip to $59,000 on June 9?

actions.description: Every individual on-chain fill contained in this transaction.

comboActions.description: Combined actions for multi-leg trades, or null when not applicable.

percentPnl.description: PnL as a percentage of cost basis.

closedAt.description: Closing block timestamp (Unix seconds); `null` while open.

resolved.description: Whether the leg market is resolved.

percentPnl.description: PnL as a percentage of cost basis.

positionValue.description: Total mark-to-market value of all open positions in USDC.

usdBalance.description: Uninvested USDC balance in the wallet.
